thread:
maria (CSM): Heads up — NewLeaf reached out, wants to spin up 2 more teams for 'Platform Plugins' and 'Embed QA'. They reported a test spike and are asking for guidance on capacity + enablement docs. @tom (AM) can you advise on renewal/commit impact? :eyes:

Tom (AM): Thanks. When's their renewal? Any chance this pushes them toward Dedicated? cc @nate (SE)

maria (CSM): Renewal in Oct 2026. Currently on mid-market plan, avg 12M tokens/month, embeddings ~480k/mo. They expect embedding qps up to 200 r/s during tests. Snippet from NewLeaf: ```recent test: 200r/s sustained for 5m, p50 latency 160ms, spikes to 350ms```

nate (SE): 200 r/s for embeddings is non-trivial. We'll need either a bigger Dedicated pool or high-throughput hosts + smarter batching/routing. Can we get logs + model name?

felix (Solutions): They're on `text-embed-3-large` (open), batch size 64. I can run a perf estimate. If they keep 200 r/s at 64b, this scales fast. @infra-bot can you run a quick capacity calc? :robot_face:

infra-bot: Queued calc job #4521. ETA ~10m. Inputs: 200 r/s, batch 64, avg tokens/request 64, model=text-embed-3-large.

maria (CSM): Also flagged by CS: product org wants docs + a 1-hr enablement walkthrough for their infra team. They want a canary plan to avoid impacting prod flows. Any playbook we can share?

Tom (AM): If they commit to +30% spend we should propose a Dedicated pilot. I'll prep a proposal. Mark as `renewal-watch` — clear expansion opportunity. @felix post perf estimate in thread.

felix (Solutions): Quick back-of-envelope: 200 r/s * 64 tokens = 12.8k tokens/s -> ~1.1B tokens/day. With current perf we'd need ~2 x medium GPU pods + autoscale buffer. Will post formal calc after infra-bot.

infra-bot: Calc complete: est GPU-hours/day: 48. Recommended: 2 reserved pods (A100-80GB equiv) with burst to 3. Predicted p95 latency ~220ms under steady load.

nate (SE): For enablement: share our embeddings best practices (batching, caching prefixes, retry/backoff). Recommend 1-hr walk-through + runbook. I can own the workshop.

maria (CSM): Thanks team. Action items: @tom prepare Dedicated pilot proposal + pricing, @felix post formal perf calc, @nate schedule enablement. I'll follow up with NewLeaf to get test logs and confirm timeline. :thumbsup:
